semiconductor_relevance: High — Takaoka Toko provides specialized inspection and environmental stress testing equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Takaoka Toko specializes in high-speed, high-precision bump inspection equipment and environmental stress testing systems for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include advanced measurement technologies such as substrate metrology and optical test systems, which are essential for ensuring the reliability and performance of semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Environmental stress testing systems (temperature, humidity, pressure, HAST)
